subject: Plan: Arrival windows & overflow strategy for SF workshop (May 14)
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara.li@acme-events.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-22T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: SF workshop — arrival windows and overflow plan (May 14)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again — excited to host Redwood's engineering offsite on May 14. A couple of logistics asks from our side so we can lock in crews and curb permits: 

- Estimated peak arrival windows at the hotel: 08:15–09:15 (most flights landing 7:30–8:40), and a smaller wave ~11:45–12:15 for late arrivals.
- We expect ~72 attendees total; estimate 50 will need shuttle or car service from SFO.
- Two VIPs will require a private sedan with a secure, escorted drop-off (hotel back entrance).

Can you confirm what Redwood will provide vs. what we should contract? Specifically: number of shuttle seats to reserve for the 08:15–09:15 window, standby plan if pickups stack up, and whether valet/curb passes are needed for the back entrance. I attached a site map and the valet pass template — you can drop in names.

I also want to know if you want us to book a rideshare buffer (credits) for overflow or if you have a preferred car service we should coordinate with.

Thanks — if we can confirm by EOD Monday we can submit the curb permit requests.

Sara
Sara Li
Event Producer — Acme Events
[sara.li@acme-events.com]

Attachments: site_map_v3.pdf (PDF), valet_pass_template.docx (DOCX)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@acme-events.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SF workshop — arrival windows and overflow plan (May 14)

Sara — thanks for the details and the attachments. Quick answers up front: we will coordinate shuttles + a valet liaison; plan A is dedicated shuttles for the 08:15–09:15 window and sedans for VIPs; plan B is rideshare credits for overflow.

Proposed slots (attached spreadsheet):
- 07:45 depart lot A (3 x 14-seat shuttles) — covers earliest arrivals and buffer for 08:15–09:15
- 08:45 depart lot A (1 x 14-seat shuttle) — covers the tail of the peak
- 11:30–12:15 on-call sedan pool (2 sedans) for late arrivals

Questions for BlueLine/parking team:
- Can BlueLine provision 3 shuttles from 07:30–09:30 and hold two sedans on standby for VIPs?
- For the hotel back entrance: will the valet liaison need two daily passes plus a staging spot for 2 vehicles (15-minute staging)?

If BlueLine confirms and Airport Parking can reserve two curb passes for 05/14 (am), we can skip the rideshare buffer. Otherwise we'll plan a fallback: $20 rideshare credit per overflow rider, preloaded to a managed account.

Marissa — assigning you as valet liaison to manage the two passes and the back entrance choreography. Please confirm and add any constraints.

Jonas — looping you for airport arrival coordination and the timeline for shuttle staging.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Field Events — Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_shuttle_slots.xlsx

From: BlueLine Chauffeurs <dispatch@bluelinechauffeurs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@acme-events.com>, Airport Parking Ops <ops@airportparking.com>
Date: 2028-04-22T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SF workshop — arrival windows and overflow plan (May 14)

Rishi / team — thanks for the heads-up. We can support the slots you outlined with the following commitments: 

- 3 x 14-passenger shuttles confirmed 07:30–09:45 (staged at Lot A). Drivers will maintain an on-call 20-minute turnaround between runs.
- 2 x sedans reserved for VIPs; we can standby as close as valet staging allows. Drivers will meet VIPs at the back entrance if provided a 10-minute staging zone.
- Overflow plan: we can provide a second-tier sedans pool (additional 4 vehicles) on a standby hourly rate; alternatively we can accept a managed rideshare buffer.

Attached is our service manifest and estimated day rate (line items in CSV). Note: to guarantee the back entrance staging we need the valet passes and explicit confirmation from hotel security by 05/07.

Also: we recommend a secondary pickup point (Point B — Market St. curb) for rideshare overflow to reduce stacking at the hotel curb. That reduces dwell time and keeps main entrance traffic flowing.

If you want us to provision additional standby sedans, let us know and we'll send a formal quote.

Best,
Maya R. (Dispatch)
BlueLine Chauffeurs
dispatch@bluelinechauffeurs.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: service_manifest.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-23T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SF workshop — arrival windows and overflow plan (May 14)

Thanks — quick internal update and next steps.

- I will pick up the two valet passes from hotel operations tomorrow and load names from the valet_pass_template. I'll send scanned copies to Sara and BlueLine when done.
- Evelyn: assigning you to confirm with hotel security that the back entrance staging (10-minute hold, 2 vehicles) is approved; please escalate if we don't have confirmation by 05/07.
- Jonas: please coordinate Lot A staging map with BlueLine (use the Drive link Rishi shared).
- If BlueLine cannot economically hold the extra sedans on standby, we approve the rideshare buffer fallback: prepay $20 credits (managed account) up to 30 uses. Finance okayed a $600 contingency for overflow.

I'll create an internal runbook page (short doc) with driver check-in times, radio channel, and overflow instructions — will push to the shared Drive by Friday. Quoting Maya's note below for visibility.
